card.name: Last word before a warning sentence ends
card.fires_on: The word "death" ending a list of harms (sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death), and the "S" in "CLE or SLE" in lupus warnings. Also a sentence-starting "It" after a TTP description.

modes.label: End of harm list
modes.description: "death" closing the list of sedation, respiratory depression, coma in opioid-benzodiazepine warnings.
modes.example: respiratory depression, coma, and<< death>>. Reserve concomitant prescribing of these

modes.label: Lupus abbreviation
modes.description: The "S" beginning SLE after "CLE or" in PPI lupus warnings.
modes.example: If signs or symptoms consistent with CLE or<< S>>LE are noted in patients receiving lans

modes.label: Sentence start after TTP
modes.description: "It" opening the sentence that describes TTP features.
modes.example: requires urgent treatment including plasmapheresis (plasma exchange).<< It>> is characterized by thrombocytopen
